news.title: From cash to credit, how Americans’ payment methods have changed in the past decade
news.summary_en: Since 2015, the share of Americans who say they use cash for all or almost all of their purchases in a typical week has fallen by half, from 24% to 12%.

news.title: Can AI Stand In for Human Survey-Takers? Not Really
news.summary_en: Synthetic surveys using digital twins do a poor job estimating the public mood and are especially error-prone for some subgroups, including Republicans and Black adults.

news.title: How urban, suburban and rural Americans engage in society
news.summary_en: Urban, suburban and rural Americans engage in public life at similar rates but differ in some of the specific activities they do.

news.title: How Pew Research Center is – and is not – using AI in our work
news.summary_en: In this post, we’ll share our current guidelines for the internal use of artificial intelligence and potential areas of experimentation.
